verdict.rationale: Okta documents Cross App Access (XAA) as a pattern for securing agent-to-app connections using OIDC. It addresses letting an AI-powered app act for a user without exposing credentials or losing admin control, and offers a hosted end-to-end playground. The evidence is limited to blog posts, and the other elements of the story are not shown. The Okta MCP server is an admin-API tool and does not make agents identities. missing for 10: token vaulting, scoped agent credentials, agents modeled as first-class identities, in-depth reference docs beyond blog posts, independent or hands-on corroboration.
